imputation.policy: causal forward fill in chronological order; leading gaps use the training-fitted median
imputation.train: causal forward fill, then training median for leading gaps
imputation.validation_test: causal forward fill seeded by the preceding split state, then training median

feature_screening.score: mean of absolute Pearson and Spearman correlations across the three targets
feature_screening.selection: top 9 ranked auxiliary features passing the training-only threshold after excluding targets and Combined mmBTU

feature_availability.forecast_origin_rule: every model input is observed at or before the forecast origin
feature_availability.GHG: historical observations only; no future GHG value or target-derived Combined mmBTU is used
feature_availability.timestamp_features: deterministic calendar features known at the origin
feature_availability.weather_features: historical measured weather only; no future weather realization is used

label_validity.definition: 1 iff the raw target value is finite and passes all pre-registered quality rules; 0 otherwise
label_validity.evaluation_policy: never impute validation/test labels; mask invalid target steps in loss and metrics
